suites.name: public
suites.scope: Real compiled backend services and Firestore emulator through injected local HTTP. Browser players use separate contexts.
coverage: Public human-only queue; no private invitation or legacy find calls
Server search aged 61000 ms still waits without bot fallback
Reload recovers original ticket and records resumeTicketId
First player disconnects while second joins; reconnect reaches same countdown and match
Both correct answers synchronize opponent scores

suites.name: private-invitations
suites.scope: Real compiled invitation and match services and Firestore emulator. Jest sharing hook uses fake native platform callback; no SMS sent. Each player has separate browser context.
coverage: Sender reload and creator opening own shared link recover same invitation
Canceled/failed/successful native-share results retain same private lobby
Shared SMS entry payload validates and joins original private countdown automatically
Both players reach gameplay
Direct inbox remains explicit; reload keeps one invitation
Notification permission fallback, enable/disable and revocation

suites.name: native-invite
suites.scope: Real UI component with controlled local transport promises; no backend authority.
coverage: One native dialog remains exclusive after 60 seconds of virtual time
Dismissal, failure, retry, capability/provider/selection replacement
Late results and unmount cannot affect replacement owner

suites.name: preview
suites.scope: Real invitation UI with controlled local read responses; no backend authority.
coverage: Exact selector and validated category/locale
Provider replacement, stale response rejection, cached inbox updates
Unavailable/malformed/foreign selector and timeout recovery
Creator own status emits resumeChallenge true

suites.name: safety
suites.scope: Real safety UI with controlled local transport promises; no backend authority.
coverage: Block/report single admission and deadline recovery
Frozen request retry; stale/invalid receipt rejection
Seat/provider/unmount replacement; confirmed block never re-enters transport
Touch targets remain inside viewport

suites.name: cancellation
suites.scope: Real lobby UI with controlled local terminal projections; no backend authority.
coverage: Rejected private acceptance stops automatic retries
Expired private poll/resume and cancelled private/public render terminal screen
Close returns once without leaving retired seat again
Late unavailable preview cannot revive closed lobby

limitations: This evidence does not exercise hosted Jest SDK identity exchange, App Check, provider iframe, actual SMS delivery, or production callable transport.
Search duration was advanced by changing only demo fixture createdAtMs; no 15-minute wall-clock soak was run.
Safety/preview/native/cancellation suites use local controlled responses and do not independently establish backend authorization.

Initial runs exposed stale fixture selectors/labels and a missing sharingEnabled callback. These were corrected in scripts only. One concurrent Chromium screenshot protocol error did not recur in final runs.
Public/private static fixtures initially served SVG images as text/html; corrected image/svg+xml and final screenshots show the coin correctly.
